Name: The Legend of the Fish King
Description:
Declaration: I am a Chinese gamer. My English is not good, so the following content is all machine-translated.
This mod was created using AI and I didn't have much time to test it. So if there are any issues, please do leave a message or contact me.
If you have any ideas, please feel free to share them with me. I'm currently preparing to create some other large-scale mod maps that are compatible with the fish king and special locations' fish king. (Perhaps there will also be some common fish species.)
Under the waters of Starlight Valley lie twelve ancient figures that are dormant. They are not ordinary catches but fragments of legends from different eras - emerging only at specific seasons, under specific weather conditions, and at specific times.

"The Legend of the Fish King" adds 12 brand-new fish king species to the game. Each fish king appears only on one of the three date windows in each season: the beginning of the month (1-3 days), the middle of the month (13-16 days), or the end of the month (26-28 days). They are distributed in rivers and oceans, and some are linked to the SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) map.

Core features
Twelve Dragon Kings, Four Seasons Cycle
Each season has 3 Dragon Kings, corresponding to the beginning, middle, and end of the month. From the溟 Crocodile in spring to the Return墟 Final鲲 Emperor in winter， the difficulty and rarity increase progressively.

Weather is deeply linked to the time period
The appearance conditions of the Dragon Kings are fully compatible with the original weather system. The溟 Crocodile only appears in the early morning of spring rain， the Burned River Python surges in the thunderstorm of summer night， and the Celestial Ice Ten-mile Dragon lies dormant in the cold sea of winter. Each time window for a Dragon King lasts no more than 4 hours， and some have only 2 hours.

Clear Division of Rivers and Seas
Each season has a fixed 1 river fish + 2 sea fish. The溟 Crocodile resides in the secret forest pond， the Ruanchuan Sturgeon swims in the western part of the Ash Forest， the Spring Tide Swordfish and the T霆渊 Devouring Sky Whale each occupy their own waters.

Independent Fish Ponds Output
After each Dragon King is placed in the fish pond， there is an exclusive output chain. During high population periods， there is a low probability of producing special items related to its mythological background.

SVE Compatibility
Some Dragon Kings are generated in the new locations added by SVE (Blue Moon Garden， western Ash Forest). Players without SVE installed can still challenge the remaining 9 Dragon Kings， including the ultimate Return墟 Final鲲 Emperor.

Pre-requisite
SMAPI (Required)
Content Patcher (Required)
Stardew Valley Expanded (Optional, only affects the spawning locations of the two King Fishes)
